catalog.description: Not every idea immediately belongs to a specific category. This section makes room for independent experiments, useful tools and projects that connect different fields.
catalog.note: These cards currently describe areas of work. Specific project descriptions will be added later.

philosophy.title: Curiosity is a starting point
intro: Interesting tasks do not always fit into predetermined areas. Sometimes a new project begins with a small question or a desire to try a different approach.
This section makes room for those ideas. Its texts are preliminary and will be refined alongside specific projects.

sections.title: Noticing possibilities
paragraphs: Everyday tasks and new tools can suggest unexpected ideas. It is important to leave room to explore them.

sections.title: Testing assumptions
paragraphs: A small experiment helps reveal whether an idea has practical value and which direction is worth pursuing.

sections.title: Keeping independence
paragraphs: Each project can have its own goal and pace of development. Connections with other areas are useful when they help solve the task.

faq.title: What to know about this area

items.question: Can I explore the projects already?
items.answer: Materials for this section are being prepared gradually. Details and available results will appear on individual project pages.

items.question: When will new materials appear?
items.answer: The section will be updated as ideas develop and descriptions are prepared. Specific dates have not been set.

items.question: Will finished results be available?
items.answer: Publication options and access will be determined individually for each project.

items.question: Can I propose an idea or collaboration?
items.answer: Yes. The form below accepts questions, ideas, collaboration proposals and discussions about supporting the projects.

items.question: Can I support development?
items.answer: You can discuss sponsorship or other support through the contact form. Arrangements will depend on the specific project.
